decisions.reason: The existing message-843 MODIFY already applies the required J_BAT short-edge placement and removes stale layout-specific attributes; no additional change is required.

Acceptance of the three-side connector layout does not change the panel-control wiring or connector specification; the integrated-board location is already represented by the existing message-843 MODIFY.

The existing message-843 MODIFY already captures the single-board topology and removal of obsolete interboard connector attributes; accepting placement along three sides adds no topology or connector-count change.
